notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). The skill guides major dependency upgrades in JavaScript projects: semver review, npm/yarn audit and outdated checks, a compatibility matrix, a staged one-major-at-a-time upgrade plan, codemods, a sample migration script, test layers, Renovate/Dependabot configs, a rollback script and lock-file/peer-dependency/workspace commands.

Medium: following it has the agent run package installers (npm install <pkg>@latest, npm audit fix, npx npm-check-updates -u, npm install --force/--legacy-peer-deps), run `npx jscodeshift` with transforms fetched from the reactjs/react-codemod master branch (SKILL.md:175-181), rewrite source files in place (SKILL.md:186-210), and run git stash/commit/`branch -D` in the rollback script (SKILL.md:313-333). Acceptable because these change only the user's own project for the upgrade they requested, the codemods come from the official React project with a `--dry` preview shown, and the staged approach runs tests after each step; review diffs and pin a codemod commit where possible.

Users should know: `npm install --force`/`--legacy-peer-deps` (SKILL.md:354-357) bypass peer-dependency safety; the rollback script's `git stash` leaves local changes stashed and `git branch -D` discards the upgrade branch on failure; the Renovate example automerges minor/patch updates.
